note: PM run (second Live Records run of the day). Checked 75 people and filed 7 bullets across 6 people, each verified on its source page by the parent and read back in the Sheet exactly once. Fresh sweep: none found — a dedicated sweep of items published Oct 20 to Nov 10 across NCPR, North Country Now, NNY360, WWNY and ClickNNY, the four colleges' news and athletics, honors announcements and health-system news found nothing new for a directory member; in-window items were already filed or known-role mentions only. Filed: Benjamin Horner's SUNY Canton President's List semester for Fall 2022 (his record covered Fall 2021 and Spring 2023); Samantha Marocco performing on horn with the Potsdam Community Band at Louisville Hometown Days in Jul 2026; Owen Kennedy relisting 928 Delamont Ave in Schenectady in Oct 2026 after a buyer failed to secure financing; and Isabella Phoebe's SUNY Potsdam Kilmer grant for 2019-2020, for a geology project on the Popple Hill Gneiss. The compounding lane filed two more Stewardship articles by Annika Greco (Apr 2026 and Jan 2026) and a correction for Amber Erwin: SUNY Canton's Spring 2026 honors list places her on the Dean's List, not the President's List — her record carried both, and the corrected fact now sits beside the old bullet, which stays under the append-only rule. Held, not filed: Ian Blunt's 2019 mortar qualification (the Army newsletter names his battalion, not the headquarters company on his record) is in Research Command as an identity question, and an Isabella Lucia bridesmaid listing in Quincy, Massachusetts (nothing ties it to SUNY Potsdam) matched the pending Nov 6 card about her living in Quincy, so this run's wedding page stands as a second source for that card instead of a new one; Angeles Felix's CMDA role, health-coach certification and Go Be founding detail rest on her own nonprofit's site and are in the ledger from the lane. Logged only, not filed and not added as cards: Zvi Szafran's Nov 5 scholarship-drive commendation (a known-role mention, the same call as Nov 6 and this morning); Jaime Bicknell's two scholarship quotes in her known role; Nicole Seward's ROOTS clinic posts (her own site only); Ben Hull's successor Allan Robinson winning the District 8 seat in Nov 2026 (a fact about Robinson, reached from Hull's seed — it corroborates the successor note already on Hull's record); and a WebMD claim that Angeles Felix's Rhode Island dental licence has expired (the same page wrongly names Tufts as her dental school, so it was not trusted; it needs a check on the Rhode Island licence lookup itself). 3 candidates added to Research Command. 11 of JD's console filing points were reconciled into the change log.
